verdict.rationale: The pack shows only outbound webhooks (including GCP Pub/Sub delivery), REST/GraphQL APIs, and a client-side Checkout SDK. All of these mean running logic on your own infrastructure or in the browser, not serverless functions or hooks executing inside BigCommerce. The vague 'extend checkout' claim does not show in-platform custom discount, shipping or validation logic, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
